page.title: Training
page.subtitle: Annotate the retrain corpus, run cloud fine-tunes on your GPU account, and configure providers.

absent.description: Install a training provider addon (for example Modal) from the Addons page, then create an entry here.

providers.empty: No provider entries yet. Add one to store credentials and run cloud jobs.
providers.nameOnlyHint: This provider type only needs a name here. Credentials open after Save if the addon exposes more fields later.

newJob.noCollections: Create at least one collection on the Frames tab before planning a job.
newJob.noProviders: Create a provider entry on the Providers tab before planning a job.
newJob.baseModelHint: One architecture per job. The trainer exports ONNX, OpenVINO, and CoreML from that run — you do not pick formats here.
newJob.advancedMulti: Advanced: train several architectures (one job each, sequential)

kpi.perCameraHint: Sorted by unannotated. % is this camera's complete ÷ corpus total. Click a row to filter the grid.

grid.couldNotLoad: Could not load the corpus page.
grid.emptyDescription: Widen the filters, or copy frames into the corpus from staging tracks and recording stills.

refusal.duplicateName: A collection with that name already exists.

actionBar.allBoxedLabel: All subjects in this frame are boxed
actionBar.allBoxedHint: Detector evaluation uses only these frames — an unboxed person counts as a false alarm. A frame with nothing in it, ticked, is a negative example.

annotationEditor.empty: No subject on this frame yet. Drag on the image to draw one, or ask for a proposal. Annotate every subject — a frame with one box and three unlabelled people teaches the model that two thirds of the people in it are background.

classes.does: Class: person, vehicle, animal, package, face, plate

modelError.does: Mark / unmark the selected box as a model error

pan.keys: Space + drag, middle drag, two fingers

unsavedGuard.title: Discard unsaved changes?
unsavedGuard.message: This frame has edits that are not saved. Leaving it now loses them.

editorNote.subjectBox: The box the pipeline recorded on this very frame.
editorNote.trackPosition: The pipeline's track position {{ms}} ms from this frame.
editorNote.verdictBox: The subject the notification reported, kept after its track was gone.

collectionsList.empty: No collection yet. Create one here, or use "Send frame to training" on a camera’s recording timeline.
collectionsList.name: Collection name
collectionsList.deleteDescription: Frames taken from the recording that are in no other collection are deleted with their boxes. Frames copied from tracks stay in the dataset.

subject.tierError: "{{value}}" is a macro class, not a label — person / postman / Marco are three different tiers
subject.label: Label

assistGap.pending: Reading which detector this camera runs…
assistGap.placement-unreadable: The detection stage of this camera could not be read, so the model it runs is unknown — not absent.
assistGap.detection-off: This camera runs no object detector, so there is no proposal to mirror.
assistGap.node-unreachable: The node that detects for this camera did not answer about its accelerators.
assistGap.device-unknown: The node does not list the accelerator this camera detects on — asking another one would propose with a different model.
assistGap.step-unknown: That node carries no object-detection step in its catalog.
assistGap.no-model: No object-detection model on that accelerator can be resolved for this camera.

workbench.noZone: A package proposal runs on the zone crop only — this camera has no zone, and running the detector on the whole frame at 0.35 proposes furniture.
workbench.proposalsTail: Accept or correct each one; drafts are not saved.
workbench.savedWithDrafts_one: Annotations saved. {{count}} unconfirmed draft was not saved.
workbench.savedWithDrafts_other: Annotations saved. {{count}} unconfirmed drafts were not saved.
workbench.proposalsFrom: Proposals come from {{model}} at {{score}}, on {{node}} — what this camera really runs.
workbench.assist: Assist — a bigger detector, AI vision
workbench.conflict: This frame was changed elsewhere (now at revision {{revision}}). Your edits are not saved.

refusal.unknownFrame: The frame is no longer in the dataset.
refusal.unreadableFrame: The frame copy could not be read.
refusal.unknownProfile: That AI profile no longer exists.
refusal.noVision: That AI profile cannot read images.
refusal.cloudNotConfirmed: The frame was not sent: sending it outside the house needs your confirmation.
refusal.malformedAnswer: The AI answered in a shape that cannot be trusted, so nothing was drawn.

assist.teacherNote: Proposed by the larger detector {{model}} on {{node}}.
assist.teacherResultSkipped_one: {{name}}: {{count}} new draft, {{skipped}} already on the frame.
assist.teacherResultSkipped_other: {{name}}: {{count}} new drafts, {{skipped}} already on the frame.
assist.draftsNotSaved: Drafts are not saved until you accept or correct them.
assist.title: Assist
assist.noNode: The camera’s detection node is not known, so no larger detector can be run there.
assist.noLarger: The detection node’s catalog has no detector larger than this camera’s for its format.
assist.profilesUnreadable: The AI profiles could not be read.
assist.noProfile: No enabled AI profile can read images. Add one under AI settings.
assist.leavesHome: This profile sends the frame outside your home, to a cloud service. Each run asks first.

confirm.title: Send this frame outside your home?
confirm.message: The frame from {{source}} will be sent to {{profile}} ({{kind}}, model {{model}}), a service outside your network, to be analysed. Only this frame, for this run.

verdictReview.correct: You answered "correct" — confirmed here, save to keep it.
verdictReview.wrongClass: You answered "wrong": it is {{class}} — saved as a reclassification once you confirm.
verdictReview.wrong: You answered "wrong" without saying what it was — review this box.
verdictReview.wrongLabel: You answered "wrong label, class OK" — the class stays, check the label.
